value.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
value.text: Kraglin shows the team Glenda, the Indigarrian he married while the others fought, and Quill scolds him for marrying on every planet they land on. Later Kraglin goes to start the ship while Quill talks with Thor.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The Guardians' leader, who scolds Kraglin for marrying.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The Guardians' pilot, scolded by Quill for marrying on Indigarr.

verdicts.why: Quill does scold Kraglin for marrying on every planet, but he does not order him to start the ship: Kraglin offers ('I'll start the ship') and Quill thanks him. Kraglin was at the ship the whole time rather than coming aboard.

Kraglin keeps watch over the Benatar during the Battle of Indigarr and then surprises the gathered Guardians, Rocket among them, by introducing Glenda as his wife. Ally fits before the Vol. 3 boss stage.
Same team scene: Kraglin introduces his new wife Glenda to the Guardians, Mantis included, after Indigarr. Ally is consistent with their earlier stage.
Both fight on Indigarr, and on the Benatar Nebula says she is putting the goats down and Mantis says 'Me too' before Thor stops them.
Mantis and Rocket fight the Booskans together and both take part in the Benatar argument with Thor over the goats.
Quill leads the Guardians at Indigarr with Nebula on the team; both watch the God Butcher distress calls and see Thor off (Nebula's 'Not her' when Thor tells Quill to take care of his crew).
Nebula and Rocket fight on Indigarr and are both in the Benatar goat argument and the goodbye to Thor.
Quill and Rocket fight together at Indigarr, are both in the goat argument, and leave together after Quill's talk with Thor.

These are not just a shared battle: all the Guardians share the on-ship scenes (Kraglin's wife, the goat argument, the distress calls, the goodbye to Thor), which counts as a scene together, and they serve on one team. Each pair's add is judged on its own items.

value.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
value.text: Miek goes to the New Asgard docks to see Korg off as he sails with Thor, Valkyrie and Jane to rescue the taken children.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Sees Korg off at the New Asgard docks.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Sails off from New Asgard to rescue the children.

verdicts.why: Korg and Miek are best friends; Miek is in the town hall scene with Korg and goes to the New Asgard docks to see Korg, Thor, Valkyrie and Jane off. That is a scene together, not only a mention.
Thor travels with the Guardians, stops Nebula and Mantis from killing the goats on the Benatar, then leaves the team to answer Sif's call.
Drax fights at Indigarr ('Terrible! We're all about to die!' to Thor), says he loves the goats and calms them during the Benatar argument, and says goodbye when Thor leaves for Sif.
In the town hall Miek writes Thor's rescue speech on the whiteboard; Thor asks her to stop the noise, then asks her to write down his last point.
Valkyrie makes Miek her secretary (they open Infinity Conez together) and after the attack orders Miek and Darryl to find out which children were taken. Boss fits from here on.
Kraglin brings Glenda to the ship and says 'This is Glenda, we got married', and Groot answers, surprised.

value.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
value.text: Groot and Mantis fight the Booskans on Indigarr as Guardians, then watch the God Butcher distress calls together on the Benatar before the team says goodbye to Thor.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate on Indigarr and the Benatar.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate on Indigarr and the Benatar.

verdicts.why: Groot and Mantis fight on Indigarr together and share the Benatar scenes (distress calls, goodbye to Thor), a scene together on one team, consistent with item 8.

In the revised 2023, Scott warns Logan not to flirt with Jean, Logan says it's good to see him, and Scott answers 'Uh-huh'. The film treats this as Scott alive again, the same person whose death is undone.
Storm arrives at the Chinese temple with Logan, Magneto and Xavier, and dies holding off the Sentinels while Logan's mind is in 1973. Xavier, not Storm, leads here, so ally is right.
Iceman is at the temple when the team sends Logan back and is killed holding off the Sentinels so Kitty can keep Logan's mind in 1973.
Colossus is in the temple when the team decides to send Logan back and fights the Sentinels to protect Kitty and Logan, dying there.
Logan finds Hank at the closed X-Mansion in 1973, and Hank joins him and Xavier in breaking Erik out, in Paris and in Washington.

value.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
value.text: Storm arrives at the temple with Xavier and dies holding off the Sentinels while his plan to send Logan's mind to the past plays out.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Dies defending the temple during Xavier's plan.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The mentor whose last plan Storm fights for.

verdicts.why: Storm does arrive with Xavier and die holding off the Sentinels, but Kitty, not Xavier, keeps Logan's mind in the past; Xavier's role is the plan.
In 1973 Hank cares for the broken Charles at the closed school, makes the serum that lets him walk, and goes with him to Paris and Washington after Cerebro finds Raven.
The group including Hank breaks Erik out of the Pentagon, and in Paris Hank fights Erik to stop him killing Mystique.
In Moscow the mutants including Iceman sacrifice themselves to buy Kitty time, and at the temple Iceman dies while Kitty holds Logan in 1973.

The rules say only what's on screen but not which cut of a film is the title; the Rogue Cut is an official extended release with real exchanges absent from the theatrical cut. The owner should pick which cut the title means (theatrical only would keep Rogue's ties here stage-free).
Logan returns to the school for answers; Xavier shows him Cerebro, says Logan must find some things out himself, and leaves him to babysit the students.
In Boston Logan gets a call from Storm, who comes to pick them up; the X-Jet with Storm at the controls arrives after the police standoff.
Logan, Rogue, Bobby and Pyro escape the raid together in Cyclops's car and head to Boston.

value.title: X2
value.text: During Stryker's raid on the school, Colossus offers to help Logan fight, but Logan tells him to help the other students, and Colossus leads them to safety.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Leads the students out of the raid at Logan's word.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Sends Colossus to get the students out during the raid.

verdicts.why: They don't round up students together: Colossus offers to help Logan ('I can help you'), Logan tells him 'Help them', and Colossus leads the students out through the tunnels while Logan fights.
Erik confesses to Charles that he told Stryker everything; later he reconfigures Stryker's Cerebro and, with Mystique directing Jason, turns Xavier on humans.
Cyclops and Xavier visit Magneto's prison together; gas knocks Xavier out and Deathstrike defeats Cyclops, and both are captured.
Wikipedia: Jean telepathically says goodbye through Xavier as she holds back the flood.
Nightcrawler teleports Storm into Cerebro, where she freezes the room to break Jason's hold and free Xavier.
At the White House Rogue hands the President Stryker's files while Xavier tells him what happened and warns him.
